reviews.title: My school experience
reviews.text:
School can feel like an endless cycle of stress, exhaustion, and pressure that never seems to let up. Every day is packed with mountains of homework, nonstop quizzes, and tests that make it seem like a single grade determines your entire future. Students are expected to wake up before the sun, sit through hours of classes, and then spend what little free time they have buried under assignments instead of enjoying life. It can feel like creativity and individuality are pushed aside in favor of memorizing facts that are quickly forgotten after the exam. Instead of being a place where students are excited to learn, school can sometimes feel more like a daily battle that drains motivation, increases anxiety, and leaves many students counting down the days until the next break.

For many students, the pressure never truly ends. Even after the final bell rings, school follows them home through homework, projects, studying, and the constant worry about upcoming assignments. The fear of falling behind or disappointing teachers and parents can make it difficult to relax or enjoy free time. Some students feel that no matter how hard they work, there is always another deadline waiting around the corner. While school is meant to prepare people for the future, the overwhelming workload and nonstop expectations can sometimes make it feel less like an opportunity to grow and more like an obstacle that leaves students mentally and emotionally exhausted.
